iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: May 12 midday scan: IAEA/PBS/BBC/AP results still show Iran at 60% enrichment and continued verification concern, while Tehran continues negotiation channels but rejects diplomacy terms requiring surrender of enrichment. No fresh device event or higher-level enrichment trigger surfaced. Active signals: nuclear rhetoric, 60% enrichment, negotiation, unreasonable diplomacy terms. Raw probability 47%. Stable/critical.

iran_conventional.name: Iran War
iran_conventional.notes: May 12 midday scan: The Hill and Gulf News carry May 10-11 reporting of US strikes on Iranian military targets after attacks on American warships, with Strait of Hormuz operations still restricted rather than shut. Trump rejected Iran proposal as unreasonable while negotiation channels remain open. Active signals: Hormuz restricted, ceasefire violation, force deploy, negotiation, unreasonable terms. Raw probability 87%. Rising/imminent.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: May 12 midday scan: CNN May 10 and Reuters May 6 reporting says fresh Israel-Lebanon strikes and rocket fire are pushing the ceasefire toward collapse, including Beirut strikes after the ceasefire and continuing military buildup pressure. Active signals: ceasefire violation, ceasefire diplomacy, military buildup. Raw probability 53%. Rising/imminent.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: May 12 midday scan: Turkey search results remain dominated by older commentary and weak social items about Turkey-Israel rivalry and Aegean rhetoric. No fresh confirmed missile launch, official nuclear rhetoric, or military buildup surfaced in the fresh window. Raw probability 8%. Falling/deterrent.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: May 12 midday scan: Al Jazeera and BBC results are mostly anniversary and ceasefire-holds analysis one year after the four-day India-Pakistan conflict. Diplomacy active by continuation of the ceasefire framework, but no fresh force deploy or live exchange trigger surfaced. Raw probability 9%. Falling/deterrent.

russia.name: Russia-NATO

Active signal: nuclear rhetoric. Raw probability 35%. Stable/critical.

china.name: China-Taiwan
china.notes: May 12 midday scan: China-Taiwan results continue to point to sustained PLA/coast-guard pressure and military buildup around blockade rehearsal concepts, but most high-quality items are older than today and no new blockade start surfaced. Active signal: military buildup. Raw probability 22%. Stable/elevated.

north_korea.name: North Korea

Active signal: ballistic missile launch. Raw probability 15%. Stable/elevated.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: May 12 midday scan: Euronews, NPR, ISW, and market-linked reporting show Russia-Ukraine strikes continued around the announced ceasefire period and ceasefire hopes remain weak. Sustained military buildup and failed ceasefire diplomacy keep the risk high. Active signals: military buildup, ceasefire diplomacy. Raw probability 83%. Rising/imminent.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: May 12 midday scan: Al Jazeera May 5 confirms Afghan accusation of Pakistani cross-border civilian deaths; newer results are weak social/video or background references. Border military buildup risk remains, but diplomacy active and lack of fresh confirmed escalation put the raw probability at 23%. Falling/elevated.

sudan.name: Sudan Red Sea Spillover
sudan.notes: May 12 morning deep scan: Sudan remains configured after RSF drone/infrastructure strikes on Khartoum and Port Sudan earlier this month; no new Red Sea maritime escalation surfaced today. Active signal: infrastructure_strike. Raw probability 17%. Stable/elevated.
